figurative_meaning_bn: পাত্রপাত্রীর ইচ্ছানুসারে প্রচলিত আচার অনুষ্ঠান না করে একে অপরকে স্বামী ও স্ত্রীরূপে বরণ
figurative_meaning_en: Marriage by mutual consent of the bride and groom without following traditional rituals, accepting each other as husband and wife
example_sentences_in_bangla: তারা গান্ধর্ববিবাহ করে সুখী জীবন যাপন করছে।
পুরনো সমাজে গান্ধর্ববিবাহকে অনেক সময় অগ্রহণযোগ্য মনে করা হতো।
example_sentences_in_english: They entered into a Gandharva marriage and are living happily.
In traditional society, Gandharva marriage was often considered unacceptable.
history: Gandharva marriage is one of the eight classical forms of Hindu marriage described in ancient texts like Manusmriti, symbolizing union based on mutual attraction without parental consent or rituals.
It draws from mythology where Gandharvas, celestial beings, marry spontaneously through love.
note: This idiom reflects pre-modern Hindu social norms and is still referenced in discussions of marital customs in Bengali literature and culture.
